scope_decision.why: Repository heads advance as PRs merge, so any single-revision alignment across layers is stale the moment the next PR lands. Chasing it would mean re-running earlier layers after every merge for no gain in truth.
scope_decision.why_this_is_safe: Traceability does not depend on alignment. Every seam and corridor receipt names the exact revision it used, and each artifact is digest-linked to the run that produced it, so any result can still be tied to the code that produced it.
scope_decision.what_is_still_asserted: That each layer RECORDED a revision for the repositories it exercised. A missing revision would still be a gap; a differing one is not.
scope_decision.contract_basis: The Layer 4 contract permits differing SHAs across layers where the receipt explains them and artifacts remain traceable. This receipt is that explanation.
